title: Polarized Online Discourse on Abortion: Frames and Hostile Expressions among Liberals and Conservatives
reasoning: The paper identifies 'religion' as one of five key frames for analyzing abortion discourse. It specifically evaluates and benchmarks the performance of transformer-based classifiers (SpanEmo, Detoxify, and RoBERTa) in identifying religious topics, religious beliefs, and moral stances within a dataset of over 3.5 million tweets.
